description: Starts Moontide: its web server on this computer and its page, which opens in a new browser tab; one click in that tab turns the sound on. Call it when the user asks, in any words, to start or open Moontide, or asks which tab or port is yours. Calling it again is safe: it gives the page address, the port and the tab title, and opens a new tab only when no page is connected. set_code starts Moontide by itself, and so does restore_version for a version that exists, so there is no need to call it before them. edit_code changes music that already plays and starts nothing. The start prompt does the same where the client offers MCP prompts.
name: start
